lrecon.description: Parties can be classified in terms of their STANCE ON ECONOMIC ISSUES such as privatization, taxes, regulation, government spending, and the welfare state. Parties on the economic left want government to play an active role in the economy. Those on the economic right want a reduced role for government.

galtan.description: Parties can be classified in terms of their views on democratic freedoms and rights. “LIBERTARIAN” OR “POSTMATERIALIST” parties favor expanded personal freedoms, for example, abortion rights, same-sex marriage, and democratic participation. “TRADITIONAL” OR “AUTHORITARIAN” parties reject these ideas in favor of order, tradition, and stability, believing that the government should be a firm moral authority on social and cultural issues.
